common.label: Rewind
common.description: Allow rewinding gameplay. Disabled in RetroAchievements hardcore mode.

common.label: Automatic save
common.description: Periodically write battery/SRAM to disk while playing.

common.label: Instant replay recording
common.description: Continuously records the last several seconds of gameplay in the background so you can save a clip of a moment that already happened with the clip shortcut. Clips are recorded at normal speed regardless of fast-forward or slow-motion. Uses extra CPU while a game is running; leave off if you don't capture clips.

common.label: Sync method
common.description: How gameplay is paced. Automatic (recommended) matches your display's refresh rate when your display can show the game's rate, and uses the game's own rate when it can't. Sync to monitor does the same thing explicitly: matching the display removes repeated and skipped frames entirely, and the pitch change it needs to do so is far too small to hear. Native timer runs at exactly the rate the game asks for and leaves audio completely untouched, at the cost of a repeated or skipped frame every few seconds on most displays. Fixed framerate runs at a rate you choose. Audio paces off your sound device instead of a clock, which keeps audio untouched but is usually less smooth, because sound devices report their progress in coarse steps.

common.label: Target framerate
common.description: Frames per second to target when using Fixed framerate sync.

common.label: Dynamic rate control
common.description: Continuously micro-adjusts the audio resample rate to keep the sound buffer near half full, correcting slow drift so audio doesn't gradually crackle or desync over long sessions. Turn off to let the emulation pacer manage the buffer on its own.

common.label: Pointer speed (gamepad aim)
common.description: How fast the left analog stick glides the on-screen cursor when a controller is used as a mouse or light gun.

common.label: Aim light guns with the mouse
common.description: When on, the mouse aims and fires any light-gun or mouse device a game uses, even if a gamepad is selected for that player. Turn off to use only the selected controller.

common.label: Turn hotkeys off
common.description: Hands every button and key straight to the game. Some systems need the whole keyboard for themselves, and there's no way to know in advance which keys they'll want.
common._note: An emulation setting, so it resolves game -> platform -> global like the rest: set it on the DOS platform and every DOS game inherits it. The per-device toggle_hotkeys shortcut is the instant escape hatch on top.

common.label: Audio latency
common.description: How much sound is buffered ahead, in milliseconds. Lower means the sound you hear tracks the game more closely; too low and the buffer can run dry between refills, which crackles. 64 suits most machines. Only takes effect when audio is next started.

app.label: Wait for the display
app.description: Holds each frame until the display is ready for it. On removes tearing and lets 'Sync to monitor' and 'Automatic' match the display exactly, at the cost of up to one refresh of extra delay. Off shows each frame the moment it is ready, which tears on most displays and stops the display being matchable at all. Takes effect when Firelight is next started.
